title: [DPB] swss docker crashes when doing DPB in DellEMC Z9332f
author: aravindmani-1
body:
#### Description

- swss docker exits in DellEMC Z9332f platform when doing DPB from 1x100G(4) to 4x100G mode.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load latest master image.
2. Breakout the default 1x400G mode to 1x100G(4) and save the config
3. Breakout 1x100G(4) to 4x100G mode and observe swss docker exits.

comments.author: zhenggen-xu
comments.body:
Please include the CLI output.  There were two issues in the ticket:
1,  Port with same speed before and after breakout would be ignored.  This should be fixed after removing the 3 lines.
2,  `None` field in CLI.   This need to be supported, and currently it was not implemented.

comments.author: dgsudharsan
comments.body:
@yxieca  This fix is required to handle the case when we do dynamic breakout to a mode with same speed but different number of lanes as described in the issue https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/9663
As this issue affects multiple vendors I recommend to prioritize cherry-picking this to 202205.
